pages.text: Your race is chosen once at character creation and $(bold)cannot be changed.$(/bold) Races modify secondary stats only — they do not touch your HP% or your damage%. That layer belongs to classes.$(br2)The interaction between race and class is where build identity comes from. The same class played by two different races has meaningfully different feel.

$(bold)The Seven Races$(/bold)$(br2)$(li)$(bold)Human$(/bold) — Versatile. Fastest leveling. $(li)$(bold)Elf$(/bold) — Fast, fragile, night-adapted.$(li)$(bold)Dwarf$(/bold) — Slow, hardy, fire-resistant, mining mastery.$(li)$(bold)Orc$(/bold) — High attack speed, high hunger drain, brutal knockback.$(li)$(bold)Halfling$(/bold) — Lucky. Efficient. Small hitbox bonus.$(li)$(bold)Faefolk$(/bold) — Nature-attuned. Iron weakness. Slow fall.$(li)$(bold)Revenant$(/bold) — Undead. Sunlight weakness. Night power.
